bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
c="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 71
docker logs --since 2026-11-19T16:55:50Z --until 2026-11-19T16:57:30Z "$c" 2>&1 | python3 -c '
import sys
s=sys.stdin.read()
for p in ["[GAYBBS_ERROR] callback_query","[GAYBBS_ERROR] message","GATE_SCREEN_HANDOFF_FAILED","WIZARD_PREVIOUS_SCREEN_DELETE_FAILED","BUG_REPORT_DELIVERY_WORKER_FAILED","WIZARD_INPUT_DELETE_FAILED"]:
 print("BOT_LOG_PATTERN_COUNT_"+str(abs(hash(p))%100000)+"="+str(s.count(p)))
print("BOT_LOG_HAS_CALLBACK_ERROR="+str("[GAYBBS_ERROR] callback_query" in s))
print("BOT_LOG_HAS_BUG_WORKER_ERROR="+str("BUG_REPORT_DELIVERY_WORKER_FAILED" in s))
'
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 72
echo BOT_ERROR_WINDOW_CLASSIFIED
